feature.name: preview_panel
feature.desc: Full-screen preview panel on mobile
feature.flow: 1. User sees chat interface by default on mobile 2. Hamburger menu button (three lines) appears in top-right corner 3. User clicks button to open full-screen preview panel 4. Panel slides in from right with smooth animation 5. Panel shows "Resume Preview" header with close button 6. Larger resume preview is displayed in panel 7. User can close panel with X button 8. Panel slides out to the right

feature.name: message_sending
feature.desc: Send user messages and receive AI responses with streaming support
feature.flow: 1. User types message in ChatInput 2. Message appears immediately in chat 3. Placeholder assistant message shows with loading animation 4. Streaming API call is made to chatApi with resume_id 5. Assistant response streams in real-time, updating the message as chunks arrive 6. Complete response is saved to database after streaming ends

rule.name: optimistic_frontend_decrement
rule.desc: On message send, decrement credits by 1 in the frontend immediately for non-premium users.

rule.name: backend_decrement_on_success
rule.desc: On successful response generation, backend decrements credits by 1 in DB for non-premium users.

rule.name: frontend_sync_on_response
rule.desc: Do not refetch user on stream end; backend credits are fetched only on page load.

rule.name: rollback_on_error
rule.desc: If the request fails, revert the optimistic decrement in the frontend.

streaming.implementation: - Uses sendMessageStream method from chatApi - Processes chunks in real-time via onChunk callback - Updates message content progressively as chunks arrive - Handles stream completion via onEnd callback - Error handling via onError callback
streaming.user_experience: - Shows "Thinking..." before first chunk arrives - Text appears progressively as AI generates response - Smooth typewriter-like effect for better UX - Maintains scroll position during streaming

feature.name: real_time_parsing
feature.desc: Markdown content is parsed and rendered in real-time as it streams

feature.name: progressive_enhancement
feature.desc: Text appears first, then Markdown formatting is applied progressively

feature.name: syntax_highlighting
feature.desc: Code blocks get syntax highlighting as soon as they are complete

feature.name: responsive_layout
feature.desc: Markdown elements adapt to available space and message container

feature.name: loading_states
feature.desc: Visual feedback during message processing
feature.states: - Loading spinner in assistant messages - Disabled input during processing - "Thinking..." text during API call - Progressive text updates during streaming

feature.name: real_api
feature.desc: Real backend API integration with streaming support
feature.implementation: - POST request to /chat/send-message-stream for streaming responses - POST request to /chat/send-message for blocking responses (fallback) - Includes message and resume_id in request - Proper error handling for failed requests - Response from AI assistant via platform service with SSE streaming

feature.name: welcome_messages
feature.desc: Dynamic welcome messages based on resume source
feature.implementation: - Different welcome messages for scratch vs upload resumes - Scratch: "Welcome aboard! I'm your AI Writer, here to save you time and boost your chances. Let's get personal: what's your name?" - Upload: "Welcome aboard! I'm your AI Writer, here to save you time and boost your chances. Let's start?" - Welcome message shown when no chat history exists - Based on resume.from_upload field from backend
